column1: # Label reliability per label source: the AUROC at which an independent re-measurement recovers the
# source's labels. The build copies it into the benchmark (label_reliability.parquet); the evaluator
# uses it as each stratum's noise ceiling (evaluate.py), and the build drops dev/test labels whose best
# source is below build.EVAL_MIN_RELIABILITY. Rule for the number: a cross-study re-measurement in the
# same line with >= 20 overlapping positives if one exists, else the source's own independent
# re-measurement (independent maps/libraries/guides/enzymes before biological replicates); a reported
# range is entered as its midpoint. Existing sources: README "Label quality" table; new human sources:
# reference/new_human/<source>.json. context_id is empty for a source-wide value.
